rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a Roberts opinion dismissing or otherwise declining merits review for lack of § 1257 finality and/or Article III justiciability, emphasizing Cox Broadcasting’s narrowness and ASARCO v. Kadish. Thomas is the likeliest separate writer, dissenting on practical finality and redressable injury, with some chance of concurrences (especially from Alito/Kavanaugh/Gorsuch) to stress jurisdictional limits while flagging views on eventual preemption merits.
